pingping.options.title: PingPing
pingping.options.group.distance.note: A marker is sized exactly like a name tag on a mob, taken from the live camera so it follows your field of view. The only departure is the floor below, without which a distant ping would shrink to a single pixel.
pingping.options.group.limits.note: Enforced by whoever runs the server. On a dedicated server its own config wins and these values do nothing.
pingping.options.group.colour.note: By default every marker takes the colour of that player's dot on the locator bar, so a marker and its dot always match.
pingping.options.option.block_needs_snea: Sneak plus middle click marks the block you are aiming at. A plain middle click then only ever finds entities.
pingping.options.option.snap_block.desc: Sneak-marked blocks sit in the middle of the block. Turn off to leave the marker on the exact spot the ray struck.
pingping.options.option.free_point.desc: With no entity in sight, a plain middle click drops a marker on the precise point you aimed at, with no block preview.
pingping.options.option.snap_cone.desc: How far off the crosshair an entity may be and still be picked up, in degrees. Zero demands a direct hit.
pingping.options.option.max_distance.des: How far a marker can be placed, in blocks. Entities beyond your client's tracking range cannot be snapped to regardless.
When nothing alive is under the crosshair, let vanilla pick block have the click instead of dropping a marker.
pingping.options.option.marker_scale.des: Size of the diamond, distance text and edge arrows.
pingping.options.option.preview_size.des: Edge length in pixels of the mob or item shown above a marker.
pingping.options.option.show_icons.desc: Draw the mob, the dropped item, or the marked block above the marker.
pingping.options.option.preview_full_bod: Frame the entire mob instead of just its head. Easier to tell apart by silhouette, but smaller.
pingping.options.option.edge_arrows.desc: When a marker is behind you or off screen, show an arrow at the screen edge pointing towards it.
pingping.options.option.server_colour.de: Let your markers take the colour of your own dot on the locator bar. Turn off to send the colour below instead.
pingping.options.option.colour.desc: The colour your markers appear in for everyone. Only used when 'Use the server's colour' is off.
pingping.options.option.sync_colours.des: Ignore everyone's custom colours and show every marker in that player's locator bar colour, so a marker is never a colour you do not recognise.
pingping.options.option.scale_with_dista: Size the marker by true perspective, exactly as a name tag on a mob at the same spot. Turn off for a fixed size on screen.
pingping.options.option.min_scale.desc: A marker never shrinks below this multiple of the marker scale, however far away it is. Raise this to make distant markers bigger.
pingping.options.option.max_scale.desc: A marker never grows beyond this multiple of the marker scale, however close you get.
pingping.options.option.sound.desc: Play a note when a marker appears. Your own is always audible; someone else's only carries within the radius below.
pingping.options.option.sound_radius.des: How close another player must be for you to hear their ping, in blocks.
pingping.options.option.directional_soun: Play the ping from the direction of the marker rather than flat at your ears. The real distance is squeezed into the sphere below, so a far ping is still audible but sounds further off.
pingping.options.option.sound_sphere.des: How many blocks away the very furthest ping is made to sound. Smaller keeps every ping loud; larger widens the sense of distance.
pingping.options.option.lifetime.desc: How long a marker stays on screen, in seconds.
pingping.options.option.max_charges.desc: How many markers can be placed back to back before the budget runs dry.
pingping.options.option.refill.desc: Seconds for an emptied budget to come all the way back.
